value: ワンパンマン (Wanpanman)
text: The title is written ワンパンマン in Japanese and read Wanpanman; English editions call it One-Punch Man.
excerpt: One-Punch Man (ワンパンマン, Wanpanman) is a Japanese manga series created by One

value: One (story), Yusuke Murata (art)
text: One came up with the story, and Yusuke Murata redrew it for the published manga.
excerpt: A digital manga remake, illustrated by Yusuke Murata

value: 2009 (self-published webcomic by One)
text: The story began in 2009 as a webcomic that One put online himself, before any publisher was involved.
excerpt: originally released as a webcomic in early 2009

value: Tonari no Young Jump (from June 14, 2012)
text: Murata's redrawn version has appeared on Shueisha's Tonari no Young Jump site since 14 June 2012.
excerpt: published on Shueisha's Tonari no Young Jump website since June 14, 2012

value: 37 volumes by July 2026
text: The remake had reached 37 collected volumes by early July 2026.
excerpt: As of July 3, 2026, 37 volumes have been published.

value: Over 38 million copies circulating by July 2026
text: By July 2026 the redrawn manga had passed 38 million copies in circulation.
excerpt: By July 2026, the manga remake had over 38 million copies in circulation.

value: Madhouse, director Shingo Natsume, 12 episodes, October 5 to December 21, 2015
text: Season 1 was animated by Madhouse under director Shingo Natsume and ran for 12 episodes from 5 October to 21 December 2015.
excerpt: The first season was directed by Shingo Natsume at Madhouse

value: J.C.Staff, director Chikara Sakurai, 12 episodes (overall 13 to 24), April 10 to July 3, 2019
text: Season 2 moved to J.C.Staff with Chikara Sakurai directing; its 12 episodes, numbered 13 to 24 overall, aired from 10 April to 3 July 2019.
excerpt: The season is animated by J.C. Staff, with Chikara Sakurai replacing Shingo Natsume as series director

value: J.C.Staff, director Shinpei Nagai, episodes 25 to 36, from October 12, 2025
text: Season 3 stayed at J.C.Staff under director Shinpei Nagai: its first cours is episodes 25 to 36 (36 in total so far), with a second cours due in January 2027 and the manga beyond season 3 still ahead.
excerpt: The season's first cours aired from October 12 to December 29, 2025

value: Wanpanman plays on Anpanman; wanpan is short for wanpanchi (one punch)
text: The Japanese name riffs on the children's hero Anpanman, with wanpan serving as shorthand for a single punch.
excerpt: Wanpanman is a play on the long-running children's character Anpanman

value: Sugoi Japan Award and Manga Barcelona seinen prize, 2017
text: In 2017 the manga took home both the Sugoi Japan Award and the seinen category prize at Manga Barcelona.
excerpt: The manga won the Sugoi Japan Award and the Spanish Manga Barcelona award for the seinen category in 2017

value: Mumen means no driver's license; a parody of Kamen Rider
text: His hero name jokes that he rides without a licence, and the character is a send-up of Kamen Rider.
excerpt: The Mumen in Mumen Rider's name translates to "no driver's license"

Garou (ガロウ): the self-styled Hero Hunter
